sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with an Orruk Warclans army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into the following sections: the Anvil of Apotheosis, Paths for lronjawz units and Paths for Kruleboyz units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Choose a Warclan.
4. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5. Choose a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Pick a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Yoof | 10 | 150
Boss | 30 | 250
Megaboss | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 2 - Fill Out The Starting Warscroll
sections.text: To begin with, your hero has the following warscroll:

sections.name: Step 3 - Choose a Warclan
sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Warclans for your KRULEBOYZ hero to belong to:
Grinnin' Blades
-4DP
Your hero has WIZARD (1) and the following ability and regiment option:
Passive
OUT OF THE MISTS
Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for ranged attacks that target friendly KRULEBOYZ units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Regiment Options | Any KRULEBOYZ units
Big Yellers
-4DP
Your hero has the following ability and regiment option:
Passive
ONLY DA BEST
Effect: Add 3" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly KRULEBOYZ units. In addition, you can re-roll 1 hit roll per turn for shooting attacks made by each friendly KRULEBOYZ unit.
Regiment Options | Any KRULEBOYZ units
Skulbugz
-4DP
Your hero has the following ability and regiment option:
Passive
SUPER KREEPY
Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons for attacks that target this unit.
Regiment Options | Any KRULEBOYZ units

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
-4DP
MONSTA-KILLA
Declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, nothing happens. On a 2-5, inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict 2D6 mortal damage on the target.
Passive
-4DP
EXTREMELY LOUD
Effect: Enemy HEROES cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.
Passive
-2DP
A KNACK FOR KILLIN’
Effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this unit’s combat attacks.
Passive
-2DP
OBSESSED WITH VIOLENCE
Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks while it is in combat. Add 1 to this unit’s Move characteristic while it is not in combat.

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
Passive
+4DP
CLUMSY RIDER
Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Companion melee weapons.
Passive
+4DP
ROARING BULLY

Passive
+2DP
PIG-HEADED
Effect: This unit cannot use RETREAT abilities.
Passive
+4DP
FAR TOO EAGER
Effect: In your charge phase, if this unit is not in combat and there are any enemy units within 12" of this unit, this unit must use the ' Charge' ability.

sections.name: Step 5 - Choose a Battle Mount
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 eligible Battle Mount for your hero.

sections.name: Battle Mounts
sections.text:
Battle Mount
-12DP
SLUDGERAKER BEAST: Sludgerakers are especially vile creatures, just like the bosses that ride these loping monsters into battle.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Sludgeraker's Talons
Companion | 6 | 4+ | 2+ | 1 | 2
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 8".
Change the Health characteristic to 14.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the MONSTER keyword.
Battle Mount
-20DP
CORPSE-RIPPA VULCHA: A Kruleboy who bends a Corpse-rippa Vulcha to their will commands the respect of their mates.
Add the following weapon and ability to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Vulcha's Talons and Beak
Companion | 7 | 4+ | 2+ | 1 | 2
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 12".
Change the Health characteristic to 14.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: MONSTER, FLY.

sections.name: Step 6 - Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades
sections.text:
If your hero has a Battle Mount, you can pick any number of eligible Battle Mount Upgrades for them.
The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.
Upgrade | Effect
Scarred 'Un
+2DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll.
Passive
BATTLE DAMAGED Effect: While this unil has 10 or more damage points:
The Attacks characteristic of its Maw-grunta’s Tusks is 4.
The Attacks characteristic of its Maw-krusha’s Fists and Tail is 5.
The Attacks characteristic of its Sludgeraker Talons is 4.
The Attacks characteristic of its Vulcha’s Talons and Beak is 5.
Fast 'Un
-3DP
MONSTER only. Add 3" to your hero’s Move characteristic.
Mean 'Un
-4DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll. You cannot pick this upgrade if your hero has another RAMPAGE ability.
Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
MEAN 'UN
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy INFANTRY unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
KEYWORDS | RAMPAGE
Loud 'Un
-4DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
LOUD 'UN
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
Weird 'Un
-5DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
WEIRD 'UN
Effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per SPELL ability.
Smelly 'Un
-5DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
SMELLY 'UN
Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target this unit if it has not charged this turn.

sections.name: Path of The Most Kunnin'
sections.text:
(KRULEBOYZ HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
SLIPPERY
Effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.
Passive
HIGHLY ACQUISITIVE
Effect: While this unit is contesting an objective, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
MORKISH KNOWLEDGE
Effect: You can re-roll casting rolls for this unit.
Passive
I'LL STAB DA 'URTY BITZ!
Effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Anti- HERO (+1 Rend).
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Your Hero Phase
YOU STAB DA SOFT BITZ!
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target’s melee weapons have Anti- INFANTRY (+1 Rend) until the start of your next turn.
Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
JUST YOU TRY IT
Declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time an enemy unit uses a CHARGE ability and ends the move within 1" of the target, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
DISCONCERTING STARE
Effect: If this unit is picked as the target of a FIGHT ability and this unit’s Control characteristic is equal to or higher than the Control characteristic of the enemy unit using that FIGHT ability, that enemy unit cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
Passive
UTTERLY UNSCRUPULOUS
Effect: Each time your opponent makes an unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

sections.name: Path of Da Sneak
sections.text:
(non- HERO KRULEBOYZ unit only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
End of Any Turn
MERELY PRETENDING
Effect: Heal (D3) this unit.
Passive
BOO! HAW HAW HAW...
Effect: Subtract 2 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
HIT DA DIRT!
Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of ranged weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit.
Passive
FEIGNED FLIGHT
Effect: This unit can use a RUN ability and still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities later In the same turn.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
LET'S GET 'EM, BOSS!
Effect: While any friendly INFANTRY HEROES are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those INFANTRY HEROES have WARD (5+).
Passive
WE'LL LOOK AFTER DISI
Effect: While each model in this unit is contesting an objective you control, add 1 to save rolls for this unit.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
PRACTICALLY GORKISH
Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly non- HERO INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.
Passive
CULL 'EM ALL
Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 5 or more models.
